note: Update this file when any tariff, VAT, or fee changes. Exchange rates are fetched live from ECB - do not add them here. Update the 'updated' date whenever you make changes.

US.note: 2.5% base + 25% Section 232 steel/aluminum tariff on all non-exempt vehicles. 25-year rule waives EPA/DOT compliance only - Section 232 still applies to exempt vehicles.

UK.note: 0% duty on EU origin vehicles under UK-EU Trade and Cooperation Agreement. 6.5% on all other origins including Japan, US, Australia.

DE.note: EU common external tariff 6.5% on passenger vehicles from outside EU. 0% within EU single market.

FR.note: EU common external tariff 6.5%. 0% within EU.

NL.note: EU common external tariff 6.5%. 0% within EU.

AU.note: 5% customs duty on CIF value + 10% GST on (CIF + duty) + 33% Luxury Car Tax on value above AUD 76,950 threshold. LCT threshold adjusted annually by ATO.

CA.note: 0% duty on USMCA origin vehicles (US, Mexico). 6.1% on all other origins including UK, EU, Japan, Australia. RIV fee $195 CAD applies to all imports.

JP.note: Japan applies 0% import duty on passenger vehicles. 10% consumption tax applies on the full value.

IT.note: EU common external tariff 6.5%. 0% within EU.

SE.note: EU common external tariff 6.5%. 0% within EU. Sweden is EU member.

CH.note: Switzerland is not EU. 7.5% import duty on passenger vehicles from all origins. Switzerland has bilateral agreements with EU but full tariffs still apply on vehicles.

US.note: No federal VAT in the US. State sales tax 0-10% applied at point of registration, not at import.

UK.note: 20% VAT on CIF value plus import duty.

DE.note: 19% German VAT (Mehrwertsteuer) on CIF plus duty.

FR.note: 20% French TVA on CIF plus duty.

NL.note: 21% Dutch BTW on CIF plus duty. Highest standard VAT in EU.

IT.note: 22% Italian IVA on CIF plus duty.

SE.note: 25% Swedish MOMS on CIF plus duty. Highest VAT in calculator.

AU.note: 10% GST on CIF value plus duty. Luxury Car Tax is additional and separate.

CA.hst_note: 5% federal GST. Provincial sales tax varies: ON 8%, BC 7%, QC 9.975%, AB 0%. HST applies in some provinces.
CA.note: Budget 13% combined federal+provincial as a safe estimate for Ontario/BC.

JP.note: 10% Japanese consumption tax on full vehicle value.

UK_to_US.note: Southampton or Tilbury to Newark, Baltimore or Jacksonville. Standard RoRo.

UK_to_AU.note: UK to Melbourne or Sydney via Suez Canal.

UK_to_DE.note: Short sea shipping UK to Bremerhaven or Zeebrugge.

EU_to_US.note: Bremerhaven, Zeebrugge or Antwerp to US East Coast.

EU_to_UK.note: Short sea Zeebrugge or Bremerhaven to UK.

JP_to_US_west.note: Yokohama or Osaka to Los Angeles or Portland.

JP_to_US_east.note: Japan to US East Coast via Panama Canal.

JP_to_AU.note: Japan to Melbourne or Sydney. Short route.

AU_to_US.note: Melbourne or Sydney to Los Angeles.

US_to_EU.note: US East Coast to Bremerhaven or Zeebrugge.

US_to_AU.note: Los Angeles to Melbourne or Sydney.

US_to_CA.note: US to Canada. Short haul, often trucked not shipped.

ZA_to_US.note: South Africa to US East Coast.

CH_to_US.note: Switzerland - ships from Bremerhaven or Zeebrugge to US.

SE_to_US.note: Sweden - ships from Gothenburg or Bremerhaven to US.

default.note: Estimated for unlisted route. Verify with freight forwarder.

US.note: CBP entry, ISF filing, customs broker fee, port handling.

UK.note: HMRC clearance, customs agent, port handling.

DE.note: German customs clearance and agent fees.

AU.note: ABF clearance, customs broker, AQIS biosecurity inspection.

CA.note: CBSA clearance, customs broker, RIV registration.

default.note: Estimated. Verify with local customs broker.

US.note: Port to door, average 200-400 miles inland. Florida/Texas ports cheapest.

NL.note: Rotterdam is central. Short final mile.

US_non_exempt.note: EPA emissions and DOT Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards compliance. Varies hugely by car age, make, and modifications needed. Get quote from certified Registered Importer.

US_exempt_25yr.note: Title and state registration only. No EPA/DOT compliance required.

UK.note: Individual Vehicle Approval test GBP 456 for non-type-approved vehicles. DVLA registration GBP 55. MOT required before road use.

AU.note: Registered Automotive Workshop Scheme compliance. Must use RAWS-approved workshop. Varies by state and vehicle.

CA.transport_canada_note: Transport Canada safety compliance required. RIV fee CAD 195.
CA.note: Not all vehicles qualify. Check CBSA admissibility list first.

JP.note: Vehicle inspection (Shaken) required. Costs vary by vehicle age and condition.

DE.note: TUV or DEKRA inspection required. EU type approval simplifies process for EU-origin vehicles.

FR.note: Controle Technique required. Certificate of Conformity needed for non-EU vehicles.

special_rules.US_rhd_note: RHD registration varies by state. Florida, Texas, Oregon, Montana are most commonly used by importers.
au_required_docs: JEVIC inspection certificate for Japanese imports
special_rules.zh_note: South African vehicles may have import restrictions in certain markets. Verify admissibility before purchase.
special_rules.general_note: Always engage a licensed customs broker in the destination country. Requirements change. Verify current rules before committing to purchase.
